_comment: MoonViT (nvidia/LocateAnything-3B). `params` field name = the bound name the DSL / weights.json reference; `from` paths index the VERBATIM config.json (the configs here carry it byte-for-byte). The vision_config block has no channel / temporal keys (Conv2d RGB), so those are declared literally via `value`. Note `vision_config.merge_kernel_size.0` — a numeric path segment indexes a JSON array. ORDER MATTERS: `expr` entries read bounds that earlier entries defined. MoonViT block norms hardcode 1e-5 in the modeling code (mlx-vlm `locateanything/vision.py::LAYER_NORM_EPS`); the projector LayerNorm shares it. `vision_rope_style` is interleaved x/y adjacent-pair (GPT-J) rotation — validated vs the mlx golden (cosine 1.0, err 4.8e-7). The learned 64x64 pos-embed table uses torch-style bicubic (a = -0.75, align_corners = false) — golden cosine 0.999999. `vision_patch_embed_flatten.channels_last`: mlx-converted checkpoints ship the Conv2d weight channels-LAST `[E, kh, kw, C]`, so it is permuted channels-first before flattening to pair with the `(c, h, w)` patch packing. `weight_leaf_renames`: the projector's `linear_1`/`linear_2` disk leaves are unnameable in the DSL (a trailing `_<digit>` reads as a layer index), so `mm.proj_in`/`mm.proj_out` fold back here.
